units.source_text: 另外，同一位高龄的病人再次弈战，可能使七段比什么都感到厌恶。

en.t: Moreover, playing another match against the same elderly invalid may have disgusted the seventh-dan more than anything else.

units.source_text: 况且对手又是名人，七段的处境就更加困难了。

en.t: And since his opponent was the Master, the seventh-dan's position became even more difficult.
